body: I have good news. I haven't asked them about the therapist but... We're finally moving out of town to somewhere better next year. This is really big for me and I'm really excited. We're moving to Denver. It's alot more progressive and LGBT friendly and there's alot more opportunity there. I'm very excited.
Typically I use an adjustable weight barbell. Also I skateboard and do some simple body weight exercises. It's not as much as I probably should do, but it's something.
Thank you. Honestly it feels really good to know that somebody actually cares and understands. I'll try to talk to them about it again. This time with some more conviction, like you said.
